task_completion.description: Open the specified rocket design file in OpenRocket.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The OpenRocket application is visible with the file 'wind_sensitivity.ork' loaded, showing the rocket design in the main view.

task_completion.description: Configure at least 6 flight simulations with varying wind speeds.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Flight simulations' tab or a simulation configuration dialog showing multiple simulation entries with different 'Average wind speed' values ranging from 0 m/s to at least 10 m/s.

task_completion.description: Execute the simulations to generate flight data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The simulation list shows green checkmarks or status indicators signifying that the simulations have been successfully run.

task_completion.description: Export the simulation results (wind speed, apogee, ground hit distance) to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export data' dialog or a file explorer window showing the creation/saving of 'wind_sensitivity.csv' in /home/ga/Documents/exports/.

task_completion.description: Write a launch readiness report with a wind speed recommendation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor (like Gedit or Mousepad) showing 'wind_report.txt' containing a summary of wind impact on apogee/ground hit and a specific maximum wind speed threshold recommendation.

integrity.description: The agent used the OpenRocket GUI rather than just command-line scripts to generate data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with OpenRocket menus, simulation buttons, and dialog boxes.

integrity.description: The data in the report and CSV matches the results shown in the OpenRocket simulation table.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values for apogee and ground hit distance visible in the OpenRocket 'Flight simulations' table match the values written in the report or CSV.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply rename an existing file but actively configured the parameters.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent manually editing the 'Wind speed' field in the simulation environment settings.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must use the file /home/ga/Documents/rockets/wind_sensitivity.ork. It must create at least 6 simulations. One simulation must be 0 m/s, and the maximum wind speed must reach at least 9.9 m/s (effectively 10 m/s). The CSV must be saved to /home/ga/Documents/exports/wind_sensitivity.csv and the report to /home/ga/Documents/exports/wind_report.txt. The report must include a specific numerical recommendation for a wind speed threshold.
